purpose: Phase 2f: resolve F4 (learned NB dispersion counterproductive). Gate-independent 4-encoder dispersion contrast (E6), dataset-clustered inference fixing pseudoreplication (E7), energy-estimator stability (E8).
metric_note: r_var_abs_log2_expr is the EXPRESSION-RESTRICTED |log2 r_var| (spec §16 E4; unrestricted r_var is discredited). energy_distance and r_var_abs_log2_expr are the only valid discriminators. Both lower-is-better; median_paired_diff = nb_stochastic - poisson_on_nb_mean (negative => NB better).
gate_note: The acceptance gate is one-sided and governs mean/procedure conclusions, but NOT this dispersion contrast: poisson_on_nb_mean holds NB's OWN fitted mean fixed in both arms, so a mean underfit cannot confound it. Gate status is reported alongside every row.

E7_clustered_inference.permutation_statistic: wilcoxon_signed_rank_sum_of_dataset_medians (robust to energy's between-dataset magnitude outliers; a mean statistic is not)

E8_energy_stability.noise_source: stochastic count sample (energy subsample is inert: max test group 286 cells <= 300)

E8_note: E8 recomputed by patch_e8.py: the energy subsample is inert (max group 286 < 300), so single-draw noise = stochastic count sample; 10 count redraws around the fixed seed-44 mu/theta.
